name: TeamStarWolf - Cybercrime and Hacktivism in Four Books Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Retrospective ATT&CK v20.0 mapping of the events in four books (Kingpin, Fatal System Error, We Are Anonymous, The Hacker Crackdown), 1987 to 2012, rebuilt from DOJ, Secret Service and FBI releases, court records and the press. No ATT&CK group, software or campaign object covers these actors. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CYBERCRIME_FOUR_BOOKS.md. Scores: 100 is behavior a primary document records with a direct fit, 75 is behavior only a book or news report records, 40 is an analogy or weak fit.
